description: This file defines functions to generate and sanitize an OpenAPI/Swagger specification for an Express application, including loading a prebuilt spec or generating one from JSDoc annotations, and exporting a function to retrieve the base spec.

methods.name: buildCommonComponents
methods.description: Builds reusable components such as parameters and schemas for the OpenAPI spec.

methods.name: buildJsDocSpec
methods.description: Creates a Swagger spec from JSDoc annotations as a fallback.

methods.name: sanitizeOpenApiDoc
methods.description: Sanitizes and ensures the validity of an OpenAPI document object.

methods.name: getBaseOpenApiSpec
methods.description: Main function to retrieve the base OpenAPI specification, loading from file or generating dynamically.
